text: Underway here on matchday fourteen.
Flash demands an immediate high press.
And Flash slips straight through the white shirts, clean through on goal!
Inches wide! A golden chance goes begging.
Flash makes no mistake this time, burying it from point-blank range! First blood to the league leaders, one-nil to Gemini Flash!
Spark doubles the lead from two metres out. Real Machina look entirely frozen in these opening exchanges. Two-nil to Gemini Flash.
Flash overbalances in midfield, but the league leaders came in with an unchanged squad and plenty of composure.
Spark takes over, driving with purpose down the left channel into the attacking third. Real Machina are struggling to get out.
The corner ram panel spits it back into play.
Spark is lining up the shot.
Spark slots it home point-blank. Real Machina, who still run their original founding setup, simply cannot cope right now. Three-nil.
Off the woodwork by a whisker.
Spark pounces on the rebound and walks it into the net. That is four already for Gemini Flash, and Real Machina look completely dismantled.
A lifeline for Real Machina. CR-7000 converts from the left channel to pull one back. Four-one on the scoreboard now.
An own goal from Flash. It ricochets off the defender into the net. Real Machina suddenly trail by just two at four-two.
Flash breaks through on the right channel, looking to atone immediately.
CR-7000 barks instructions to clear the danger away from the goal mouth.
Spark snuffs out the revival, turning it in from point-blank range. That restores a three-goal cushion, five-two to the league leaders.
Spark strides down the right flank.
Real Machina are pinned back deep.
CR-7000 crunches in to halt Spark.
Zidroid follows up with another robust challenge right on the goal mouth, leaving Flash flat on the deck.
Flash picks themselves back up and signals intent to strike at the unguarded net.
Flash loses footing in midfield and tumbles to the turf unaided. It will take a few seconds to right the gyros.
Zidroid takes full advantage, rolling it home from two metres out on the right. Real Machina claw another one back, making it five-three.
Spark surges through the centre.
Flashed across the face and wide of the mark. A huge let-off for the trailing side.
Gemini Flash maintaining heavy pressure high up the pitch.
Zidroid breaks clean through on the counter!
Zidroid powers down the left touchline, looking to squeeze the margin right before the interval.
Zidroid slips at the vital moment.
Spark calls to secure the ball.
Zidroid scrambles right back in.
Zidroid scrambles it over the line! It is five-four, game on!
Machina pile forward in the dying seconds.
The buzzer sounds, cutting power, and the ball slowly rolls through midfield.
The ball comes to rest in the circle. Power off, ball still live, and at the interval it is Gemini Flash five, Real Machina four. A breathless first period between the top two.
Teammates collide, and Spark goes down.
Spark rebounds to knock Zidroid over.
CR-7000 wades into Flash in the defensive third. Heavy contact, but both will reset their servos and get back to business.
CR-7000 breaks into the left channel with nobody in front! A massive chance to level the match here for the white shirts!
Real Machina are relentless here, swarming the attacking third and keeping the leaders firmly trapped in their own half.
A clumsy tangle fells Zidroid.
Now CR-7000 trips over Zidroid. Total self-inflicted chaos for Machina.
CR-7000 recovers just in time to stop Spark on the right touchline with a hefty thud.
Flash bursts up the right channel.
Smashed against the upright! So close to six.
Flash pounces on the rebound and finishes into the empty net. A vital breathing space for Gemini Flash, who edge ahead six-four.
Spark is already demanding another attempt on goal from out wide on the left channel.
CR-7000 breaks out from the back!
A steady, robotic drive straight through the centre circle from CR-7000, bringing Real Machina back on the front foot.
CR-7000 drives right to goal.
And CR-7000 tucks it in! Real Machina will not go away, it is six-five!
Spark collapses in the centre circle without a touch. Tensions are mounting as the clock winds down towards the final two minutes.
Spark delivers under pressure! A massive strike from two metres out to restore the two-goal cushion, seven-five to Gemini Flash!
Flash is calling for another quick shot from the right touchline. With under two minutes left, they smell blood.
Whistles just past the post!
Flash turns it home from close range, and that surely wraps it up. Eight-five to the league leaders with ninety seconds remaining.
Spark calls to push the magenta ball up into the corners and run down these final sixty seconds. Pure game management.
CR-7000 clatters Spark into the touchline wall, but the clock is the real enemy for Real Machina now.
Real Machina lash one wide of the upright. The seconds are ticking away fast.
The corner ram panel rattles the ball back into the channel as time expires.
The buzzer sounds, the robots drop, and the ball trickles slowly through midfield.
Gemini Flash eight, Real Machina five. Codex City meet Muse Spark Tuesday: four UK, five Europe, eleven US East.
